vulkan_icd.why: the image has no Vulkan ICD, so every d3d12 case SKIPs at 'device' (L6/L6b). The image's own OOBE installs Lavapipe when online from a public LiberNT release; put that MSI on the payload and the launcher installs it offline (msiexec /qn) before the fixtures run.
vulkan_icd.payload: mesa\libernt-mesa-llvmpipe-26.2.2-1-amd64.msi (150 MB class; the launcher tolerates its absence: then only the no-ICD outcome is recorded)
vulkan_icd.note: Mesa 26.2 Lavapipe advertises VK_EXT_conservative_rasterization and VK_EXT_fragment_shader_interlock; if msiexec fails on this image, report the exit code and the reg query output and run anyway.
